content: If Bus Mirroring is enabled globally (configuration parameter LinIfBusMirroringSupported) and has been activated with a call to LinIf_EnableBusMirroring() for a LIN channel, the LIN Interface shall call Mirror_ReportLinFrame() each time after reading the LIN Driver’s status for a Tx slot on that channel, providing the transmitted data when the status is LIN_TX_OK, and otherwise a NULL pointer.
